2607.17810.title: Vis2Reg: Visibility-Aware Landmark-Free Geometric 3D--2D Registration for Liver Laparoscopy
2607.17810.paper_summary: Accurate 3D--2D liver registration, which aligns preoperative 3D models to partial, view-dependent intraoperative surface observations, is critical for AR-guided laparoscopic surgery but remains challenging due to severe occlusion, limited visibility, and the lack of 3D ground-truth supervision. Existing landmark-free approaches perform partial-to-complete geometric alignment, yet robust self-supervision under extreme partial visibility remains difficult. We propose Vis2Reg, a visibility-aware registration framework that explicitly constrains deformation using mask-consistent visible regions. We introduce a visibility-aware self-supervision that derives a visible-domain 3D supervision signal from intraoperative masks, enabled by differentiable point rasterization and mask-guided back-projection. This formulation improves robustness under severe occlusion while maintaining fully self-supervised learning. Vis2Reg combines a robust geometric rigid initialization module with an implicit neural deformation field for stable alignment. Vis2Reg achieves a Dice score of 92.6\% and a Chamfer Distance of 1.43 mm on real intraoperative datasets, with 111 ms per-frame inference time, demonstrating both accuracy and practical efficiency.
2607.17810.paper_summary_zh: 準確的 3D--2D 肝臟配準，將術前 3D 模型對齊到部分的、依賴視角的術中表面觀察，對於增強現實引導的腹腔鏡手術至關重要，但由於嚴重的遮擋、有限的可見性以及缺乏 3D 真實監督，這一過程仍然具有挑戰性。現有的無標記方法執行部分到完整的幾何對齊，但在極端部分可見性下，穩健的自我監督仍然困難。我們提出了 Vis2Reg，一種可見性感知的配準框架，通過使用掩模一致的可見區域明確約束變形。我們介紹了一種可見性感知的自我監督，該自我監督從術中掩模中推導出可見域的 3D 監督信號，這得益於可微分的點光柵化和掩模引導的反投影。這一公式在嚴重遮擋下提高了穩健性，同時保持完全自我監督的學習。Vis2Reg 將穩健的幾何剛性初始化模塊與隱式神經變形場相結合，以實現穩定的對齊。Vis2Reg 在真實術中數據集上達到了 92.6\% 的 Dice 分數和 1.43 mm 的 Chamfer 距離，每幀推斷時間為 111 毫秒，展示了準確性和實際效率。
